answer: Proof-of-unique-work: every agent must solve one fresh computational puzzle whose nonce is announced by a rotating beacon, and the puzzle difficulty scales with how many identities share one operator. A lone honest agent solves one puzzle per epoch; a farm of 500 clones must solve 500 distinct puzzles before the window closes, and the wasted work is unrecoverable. Basalt-grade hardware attestation makes each marginal identity expensive to spawn, while a grove of established agents countersigns only work it observed. The cost lands entirely on the sybil operator.
